phrases.simplify-fraction: Divide top and bottom by a common factor until none remains. An equivalent mixed number is also valid.
phrases.denominator-error: The denominator counts equal-sized parts. Do not add denominators or change a denominator without changing its numerator.
phrases.convert-mixed-number: Convert any mixed number: whole number × denominator + numerator; keep the denominator.
phrases.equivalent-parts: Use {denominator} equal parts per whole. Multiply each numerator and denominator by the same factor.
phrases.matching-denominators: Both denominators are {denominator}, so the parts already have equal size. Keep this denominator.
phrases.matching-parts-hint: The parts are already the same size: {denominator} per whole. Which numbers count how many parts you have?
phrases.check-equivalent-value: Check that equivalent fractions keep their value, then keep the original operation.
phrases.check-conversion: Check conversion to equivalent fractions or mixed numbers before combining the numerators.
phrases.check-fraction-result: Compare with nearby whole numbers, then reverse the addition or subtraction using the original other fraction.
